findings_for_planner_reviewer: FINDING A (merge is the COMMON path, not an edge): CS-order not-founds almost always BOTH-fire. The order get-results tool relaxes on the date axis and returns date alternatives whenever the (fuzzy-matched) customer has ANY order; the CRM even fuzzy-matched pure-gibberish customer names (SMC202606-9999 -> did-you-mean order codes; 'Zxqmnbvlkjh Trading' -> a real customer with deliveries) to real records with orders. So Δ4's _merge branch is high-traffic. The plain member-only path (selection_context=member_offer WITHOUT suggest) is only reached when the token yields ZERO resolver alternatives (e.g. a no-digit order token like 'ABCDEFGHXYZ'). Safe, but reviewers should treat the merge render as the primary CS-order-miss experience.

FINDING B (crux resolved safe): a date reply while member_offer is open does NOT misfire as a member pick — verified end-to-end. The reformulator classifies it business_query/date and reuses the prior customer; reference_positions stays [] (no date digit mined). No assignment.
